message: In the twin-rack cold room enclosure (C4), the hinged door air exchange has uncounted infiltration problem. To check it I used hand air-change estimate reusing the door conduction estimate (E10) and the combined thermal load (E9), Sam. I found about 0.6 kilowatt-hour thermal per day for ten brief openings versus 30.2 kilowatt-hour worst-day thermal, according to American Society of Heating, Refrigerating and Air-Conditioning Engineers Handbook Refrigeration, 2022. I propose self-closing hinged door with Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC, flexible plastic strip) strip curtain to cut exchange by about 70 percent. My position: not ready because steady-load add-on needs your thermal sign-off. In the 100 millimetre Polyurethane insulated enclosure (PU, closed-cell foam insulation) (C4), the door perimeter seal has leakage persistence problem. To check it I used gasket review reusing the door and canopy detail sketch (E11), Manager. I found double magnetic gasket with cam lock holds conduction near 13.8 watts, according to Indian cold-room panel maker ISMAP, 2024. I propose 90 millimetre insulated leaf with double magnetic gaskets plus step threshold and replaceable seals. My position: not ready because system autonomy closure by others is still open.
